test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

The survival of theatre has depended on the creation of ______ formats.
solution:
The correct answer is "new."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We need an adjective (positive degree) in the blank that can modify the noun **"formats."**
 
• The reason is that **"new"** is the appropriate adjective to describe the creation of formats, indicating that these formats are recent or modern, contributing to the survival of theatre.
 
• **"New"** in this context doesn't necessarily compare the formats to others; it simply emphasizes that the creation of formats, regardless of how they compare to each other, has been essential.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

**Correct sentence**: *The survival of theatre has depended on the creation of **new**__ formats.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• **Newly: **Adverb form of the word "new"
 
• **Newer: **Comparative degree of the word "new"
 
• **Newest: **Superlative degree of the word** "new"**
